SAFFRON benchmark
	

The benchmark tasks from SAFFRON (paper, code):
8 spatial transcriptomics datasets with known, quantifiable spatial variation τ, for evaluating whether the
embeddings of a spatial (or single-cell) foundation model capture spatial variation at different scales.

Global tasks (Fig. 2a): 1-D spatial gradients of gene expression (global/).
Local tasks (Fig. 4a): microenvironments around amyloid-β plaques in Alzheimer's disease brains (local/).
